ValidationRule.description: Rule to make the closure comments and Closure Reason field mandatory, when the opportunity is Closed - Accepted and Closed - Not Accepted.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND($RecordType.DeveloperName ='Business_and_Government' , ISCHANGED( StageName ), OR(ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Closed - Accepted"), ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Closed - Not Accepted")), OR(ISBLANK( Closed_Reasons__c ) , ISBLANK( Other_reasons__c )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select a Closure Reason and add in Closure Comments.
